Maruzensky finished her "Make Debut" race 
full of joy.

Her spirits soaring from a sensation that 
can only be felt on the track, she sets 
her sights on the grandest stage of all to 
crown the Junior-tier champion—

They set their sights on the Asahi Hai 
Futurity Stakes as the race that would 
serve as their first step.
